name: Data Science (Min)

blocks.name: Program Requirements

rules.name: Linear Algebra
rules.notes: Students who have taken CME 100 are recommended to take ENGR 108 to satisfy this requirement.

rules.name: Probability
rules.notes:
Students who take STATS 117, CS 109, EE 178 , or MS&E 120 for their major or another minor are required to take STATS 118 or MATH 151 to satisfy this requirement.
STATS 116X is only recommended for advanced undergraduate students with strong mathematical preparation, no prior background in probability, and preference for an accelerated pace.

rules.name: Data Science Methodology
rules.desc: Students must complete one course fulfilling Data Science methodology from a cognate field of interest. Suggested courses are included here. The Data Science Program must approve other courses via requirement inquiry form.

blocks.notes: For any questions about program requirements, please reach out to the Student Services Specialist via datasciencemajor-inquiries@lists.stanford.edu.

grading: All courses for the minor must be taken for a letter grade.
policies: The only courses that can be double-counted between the data science minor and a major or other minor are CS 106A or CS 106B, MATH 51, and STATS 110. See the university double-counting policy page for more details. Beyond that, students need to find another suitable course to satisfy the requirements of the minor and expand their skill set.
transferPolicy: The program must approve transfer credit before it can be used toward your Data Science minor requirements. It is considered on a case-by-case basis in conversation with the Data Science Program Director, the rest of the Data Science team, and the department of the required course. Please see our Transfer Credit page for more information.
reviewNotes: The audit checks one course from each of the six lists (linear algebra, programming, probability, statistics, data mining and machine learning, and data science methodology), each taken for a letter grade, and the 22 units of the minor. You check by hand courses the program approves outside the lists, that you take STATS 118 or MATH 151 for probability if your major or another minor already uses STATS 117, CS 109, EE 178 or MS&E 120, and that no course other than CS 106A or 106B, MATH 51 and STATS 110 is also counted toward your major or another minor.
